summary.name: Taskade Genesis
summary.one_liner: Taskade Genesis is an AI app builder that turns a text prompt into a hosted, full-stack business app (CRM, dashboard, client portal) with data, AI agents, and automations wired in.
use_cases: Build a CRM or sales pipeline tracker from a prompt
Create branded client portals with sign-in
Track customer health, churn risk, or licenses
Publish AI chat agents embedded on a website
Automate workflows across Slack, Stripe, Google Sheets
Prototype an internal tool without an engineering team
summary.what_it_does: Taskade Genesis generates a live business app from one natural-language prompt, combining projects/databases, AI agents, and automations in one workspace. Apps can be cloned from a community gallery and then edited with your own data. AI agents can be trained on files, URLs, and project data, given custom tool schemas, and published publicly or embedded on a website. Automations support branching, looping, and filtering across 100+ integrations, with durable execution and retries for failed steps. Pro and above allow export to GitHub or import/export of a .tsk file.
notable: Workspace DNA loop linking memory, AI agents, and automations
Clone ready-made apps such as customer health dashboards and license managers
Bring-your-own API key support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI and others on paid tiers
Export to GitHub or .tsk file import/export
caveats: Free plan has only 1 AI agent, 10 automation runs per month, and no AI credits until earned or purchased
Pro is $10/mo billed annually; many features (all views, 100+ integrations, paid models, Reasoning tier) require paid plans
Automations on Pro/Business tiers and some features depend on plan level; Claude BYOK limited to Pro and up
